subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.

He studies the subject known as __the scientific study of insects.__
solution:
The correct answer is: **Entomology**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Entomology"** is the branch of zoology concerned with the study of insects. It involves researching their development, anatomy, physiology, behavior, distribution, ecology, and classification. (कीट विज्ञान)

 
 
• **Example: **Entomologists may study the role of insects in spreading diseases or their importance in pollination.
 
 
 
• Hence, the scientific study of insects is known as **'Entomology'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Entomology**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Alchemy **(रसायन विद्या): An early form of chemistry, with philosophic and magical associations, aimed at the transmutation of base metals into gold, the discovery of a universal cure for disease, and the discovery of a means of indefinitely prolonging life.

 
 
• **Example:** Alchemy is often considered the precursor to the modern science of chemistry.
 
 
 
• **Etymology **(शब्द उत्पत्ति विज्ञान): The study of the origin of words and the way in which their meanings have changed throughout history.
 
 
• **Example: **Understanding the etymology of words can provide insight into the history and evolution of a language.
 
 
 
• The subject "Biology" is a natural science concerned with the study of life and living organisms, including their structure, function, growth, evolution, distribution, and taxonomy. (जीव विज्ञान)
 
 
• Example: Studying biology helps us understand the living world and the ways its many species (including humans) function, evolve, and interact.
